content.text: CI changes go without a changelog entry. Validating YAML, then committing.

arguments.command:
cd $GITHUB_WORKSPACE && python3 -c "import yaml;yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml'))" && git commit -qam "ci: upgrade pi-action to v2.3.0, pit to v0.35.1, and trust the project's functions

Refs #358" && git push -q -u origin ci/upgrade-pi-action 2>&1 | tail -2 && gh pr create --title "ci: upgrade pi-action to v2.3.0 and use it better" --body "Refs #358

## Changes to \`.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml\`

- **pi-action v2.2.0 → v2.3.0** (pinned to the commit SHA \`12bf89d\`). What this brings in:
  - v2.2.1: a reply cut off by \`max_tokens\` no longer ends the run, and pi-action stops installing its own git hooks. Those hooks rejected this repo's \`release: v0.35.x\` commits.
  - v2.2.2: replies are no longer posted twice.
  - v2.3.0: files left uncommitted carry over between runs (\`refs/pi/worktrees/<n>\`), the workflow log shows each step, and a \`git fetch\` of \`refs/pi/*\` no longer breaks the run.
- **pit extension v0.35.0 → v0.35.1**, the latest release.
- **\`trust_project: true\`**: \`AGENTS.md\` tells the agent to use \`delivery.validate()\`, \`delivery.prepare()\`, and the other functions in \`.pi/functions\`. With trust off, pit loads none of them in CI (\`context.get().projectFunctions\` is \`[]\` in this run), so the agent couldn't follow the repo's own workflow. Turning it on also applies \`.pi/pit.json\`.
  - **Security:** only OWNER/MEMBER can start a run (pi-action's default \`allowed_associations\`). Comment events check out \`main\`. Fork PRs get no secrets, so they can't mint the App token. The \`.pi\` files that load are therefore ones a maintainer controls.
- **\`timeout: 2400\`**: pi-action's default limit is 30 minutes, which cut off long tasks well before the job's 45-minute limit. 40 minutes leaves time to save the thread.

## Not changed
- Triggers, the \`if:\` filter, concurrency, and permissions already match pi-action's recommended workflow (\`docs/workflows.md\`).
- \`worktree_snapshot_exclude\`: \`.gitignore\` already keeps \`node_modules/\`, \`coverage/\` and logs out of snapshots, and the repo has no secret files.

## Testing
- I only checked that the workflow file parses as valid YAML. The new settings haven't run yet: the first \`@pi\` request after merge will show whether project functions load and whether the 40-minute timeout holds.
- Smoke check after merge: start a run with \`@pi\` and confirm the agent can call \`delivery.validate()\`." 2>&1 | tail -1
